summaryZh: ICCL 开发用于宽带数据通信与计算的模拟和混合信号集成电路。研究使用先进 CMOS、硅光及异构集成工艺，涉及收发器、光调制器、均衡、SerDes 和时钟数据恢复。

evidence.quote: Tzu-Chien Hsueh leads the Integrated Communication Circuits Lab (ICCL) at the University of California San Diego (UC San Diego).
The primary research objective is to develop analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits utilizing advanced CMOS, silicon photonics, and heterogeneously integrated process technologies
wireline electrical transceiver analog front-ends, optical modulators, silicon-photonics interposers, channel equalization, SerDes, CDR
